description: BENE.BIZ Tile Search Slicer visual lets users search and filter large datasets through interactive tiles, with extensive customization for each tile and panel. It provides two panels (selected and unselected tiles), powerful search and selection controls, and advanced layout and formatting options for highly usable Power BI reports. Looking for a modern, tile-based way to explore your data? The BENE.BIZ Tile Search Slicer delivers an intuitive search and selection experience that helps users quickly find and focus on what matters — all while remaining highly customizable to match your report’s look and feel. Free features You can use the BENE.BIZ Tile Search Slicer for free with the following features: Panels & layout — Work with selected and unselected panels and define the number of columns per panel as well as the color of the tiles in each panel. Search & selection — Search items in your data and instantly see search results in both selected and unselected panels. Search can be repeated multiple times to search for different terms. Reset filter — Use "reset filter" button to clear the selection. Tile appearance — Customize tile font, size, alignment, border, corner radius, padding and hover color. Amount of visible selections — Set how many selected items are visible and set the color of "more results" text. 💎 PRO features The PRO version of the BENE.BIZ Tile Search…
